name: Tuesday Night Worlds (TNW)
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:00 pm, from the parking lot at Orchard and 7th Streets in Newport. Several groups, from social to fast. The calendar lists Oct 13 as the last regular ride, then a scavenger hunt on Oct 20 and Biketoberfest on Oct 27.

start_location.name: Parking lot at Orchard and 7th Streets, near Reser Bicycle Outfitters

visitor_notes: Pick the group that fits your pace. Check the TNW Facebook group or Instagram before each ride for routes and any change.
description: A weekly Tuesday-night ride that pulls riders in from across Cincinnati and Northern Kentucky. It offers a social group, a steady group and faster groups, so riders pick their own pace. Routes and groups change week to week; the organizers post updates on a Facebook group and Instagram.
evidence: Queen City Bike's calendar lists Tuesday Night Worlds for Oct 6, 13, 20 and 27, 2026 from the Newport lot; the event text says Oct 13 is the last regular ride (read Oct 1, 2026). The calendar prints times in UTC: 10:00 PM UTC is 6:00 pm Eastern.

refresh.notes: Queen City Bike's calendar shows each date. The organizers post route and group changes on the TNW Facebook group and Instagram. Regular rides end Oct 13.

name: Saturday Breakfast Ride (Goshen)
schedule: Saturdays from the Goshen Kroger lot. Oct 3: 9:00 am. From Oct 17: 8:00 am (the Oct 10 listing shows no time). The club calendar lists it through Oct 31, 2026.
pace: Several speed groups; pick one you can keep up with
visitor_notes: Registration is not required but the club appreciates it. Helmet required. Download the RideWithGPS route before you go.
description: A 35-mile Saturday ride over gentle rolling roads east of Cincinnati, with a mid-ride stop at Plainfolk Cafe. There are several speed groups, so new riders pick a group they can keep up with. Route files are on RideWithGPS.
evidence: The Cincinnati Cycle Club's calendar lists the Saturday Breakfast Ride from the Goshen Kroger for Oct 3 (9:00 AM), Oct 17, 24 and 31 (8:00 AM) and Oct 10, 2026 (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The club calendar lists each date with its start time. The start moves with daylight. The ride rider-line is a Google Group the page links to.

name: Återhämtning's Thursday Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 5:45 pm, from the parking lot at East Alexandria Pike and Route 27 in Campbell County, Kentucky. The club calendar lists it through Oct 29, 2026.

start_location.name: Parking lot at East Alexandria Pike and Route 27
start_location.address: East Alexandria Pike and US 27, Cold Spring, KY

pace: Advanced; 25 to 40 miles depending on group and time of year
visitor_notes: Bring lights as the evenings get darker. The route link is on the club calendar event.
description: An advanced, no-drop ride through the hills of Campbell County, Kentucky. The ride regroups at intersections and at the tops of hills. Routes run 25 to 40 miles depending on the group and the time of year.
evidence: The Cincinnati Cycle Club's calendar lists this ride for Thu Oct 1, 8, 15, 22 and 29, 2026 at 5:45 PM (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The club calendar lists each Thursday. The town is taken from the street intersection; check the map on the event page.

name: BMS Tuesday and Thursday Evening Ride
schedule: Tuesdays and Thursdays, 5:30 pm, from Bellbrook Middle School. The club calendar lists Oct 1, 6 and 8, 2026.
pace: A 19-20+ mph, B+/A- 18-19 mph, B 16-17 mph (three groups depending on attendance)
visitor_notes: Bring a headlight and a taillight.
description: A fast-paced evening road ride from Bellbrook Middle School. The club runs three groups depending on who shows up: A at 19 to 20+ mph, B+/A- at 18 to 19 mph and B at 16 to 17 mph.
evidence: The Dayton Cycling Club's calendar lists the BMS ride for Thu Oct 1, Tue Oct 6 and Thu Oct 8, 2026 at 5:30 PM (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The club posts each date a week or two ahead; later dates may not be up yet.

name: KBC Friday Morning Women's Ride
schedule: Fridays, May through October, from Texas Drive Park. Rolls at 9:30 am in May, September and October, and 9:00 am in June, July and August.
description: The Kalamazoo Bicycle Club's women's ride on Friday mornings, run from the same park as the Monday night ride.
evidence: The club's rides page, headed 2026 ride season (March 10 to Oct 31), lists the Friday Morning Women's Ride May through October from Texas Drive Park, 9:30 AM in October (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The club's ride page states the season and start times. The last Friday of the season is Oct 30.

name: TCBA Monday Night B Ride (Old Town and DeWitt)
schedule: Mondays, 6:00 pm to 7:30 pm, from the Brenke Fish Ladder. The club calendar lists Oct 5, 12, 19 and 26, 2026. Lights required.
pace: 15-17 mph, two optional sprints with a regroup
visitor_notes: Lights are required. Helmets are required on all TCBA rides.
description: A 23-mile no-drop road ride through Old Town and DeWitt at 15 to 17 mph, with two optional sprints and a regroup after each. The group hangs out at Ozone's Brew House afterward.
evidence: The TCBA ride calendar lists the B Ride for Mon Oct 5, 12, 19 and 26, 2026 at 6:00 PM from the Brenke Fish Ladder, no drop (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: TCBA's ClubExpress calendar lists each date and ride leader.

start_location.name: Grand Ledge Public Schools Administration Building parking lot
start_location.address: Grand Ledge Public Schools Administration Building, Grand Ledge, MI

pace: Z ride in TCBA's own rating; 40 to 55 miles

name: Cadillac Pathway No Drop Group Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, 6:30 pm, from the Cadillac Pathway trailhead. The NMMBA calendar lists Oct 7, 14, 21 and 28, 2026.
description: A beginner-friendly, no-drop group ride on the Cadillac Pathway. The group may split into smaller groups as numbers allow, but nobody gets left out. Ride updates go on the association's Facebook page.
evidence: NMMBA's calendar lists the Cadillac Pathway No Drop Group Ride for Wed Oct 7, 14, 21 and 28, 2026 at 6:30 PM (read Oct 1, 2026).

name: TAB Adventure Ride (D)
schedule: Saturdays, 9:00 am in April and October, 8:00 am May through September. Start location changes weekly; the club posts it on its Facebook group.

start_location.name: Varies by week; posted on the TAB Facebook group

visitor_notes: Helmets are required on all TAB rides. No headphones or earbuds. Check the TAB Facebook group for the week's start.
description: The slower, no-drop version of Toledo Area Bicyclists' Saturday Adventure Ride, a new group for 2026. It follows the same routes and start as the B group. Routes are generally 40 or more miles.
evidence: TAB's club rides page, which lists new 2026 routes and groups, shows the Adventure Ride D group (new, no drop) Saturdays at 9:00 am in April and October (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The ride table gives the monthly start times. Each week's start location is on the TAB Facebook group.

name: TAB Meandering Ride (E/F)
schedule: Saturdays, 9:00 am in April and October, 8:00 am May through September. Start location changes weekly; the club posts it on its Facebook group.

start_location.name: Varies by week; posted on the TAB Facebook group

visitor_notes: Helmets are required on all TAB rides. No headphones or earbuds. Check the TAB Facebook group for the week's start.
description: Toledo Area Bicyclists' easiest Saturday ride. Routes vary and run 20 to 40 miles, and the ride is no drop.
evidence: TAB's club rides page, which lists new 2026 routes and groups, shows the Meandering Group (E/F, no drop) Saturdays at 9:00 am in April and October (read Oct 1, 2026).

name: Wednesday Show & Go Social Ride from Springfield Beer
schedule: Wednesdays, meet 5:30 pm in the lot behind Freddy's at Springfield Beer Company. The club calendar lists it through Oct 28, 2026.

start_location.name: Parking lot behind Freddy's, Springfield Beer Company

visitor_notes: Lights are strongly suggested. The calendar posts weather cancellations.
description: A casual 15-mile cruise on the Sangamon Valley Trail to Stuart Park and back at 10 to 12 mph, starting and ending at Springfield Beer. Through Oct 7 the calendar calls it the Slow C social ride, no drop; from Oct 7 it is a show and go.
evidence: The Springfield Bicycle Club's public Google Calendar lists the Show & Go Social Ride from Springfield Beer every Wednesday at 5:30 pm through Oct 28, 2026, and the Slow C version through Oct 7 (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The club's Google Calendar lists every ride and cancellations. Weather changes are posted there.

name: V-Park Weekend Rides
schedule: Saturdays and Sundays, 8:00 am, from Vredenburg Park. The club calendar lists Saturdays through Oct 31 and Sundays through Nov 1, 2026.
pace: Saturday faster steady pace; Sunday steady 18-19 mph
visitor_notes: No obligation to take a pull; ride within your limits.
description: Springfield's weekend fast rides. Saturday is a faster steady pace, still no drop. Sunday is a steady 18 to 19 mph, no drop. Nobody has to take a pull.
evidence: The Springfield Bicycle Club's public Google Calendar lists V-Park Fast Rides at 8:00 AM Saturdays through Oct 31 and Sundays through Nov 1, 2026, both no drop (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The club's Google Calendar lists the ride and the ride leader's notes.

name: Friday All Generation Kickapoo Rail Trail Ride
schedule: Every other Friday, meet 5:45 pm, roll 6:05 pm, from the Urbana Walmart trailhead of the Kickapoo Rail Trail. 2026 dates: Oct 9 and Oct 23 are the last two.

start_location.name: Urbana Walmart Kickapoo Rail Trail trailhead
start_location.address: Kickapoo Rail Trail trailhead at Walmart, Urbana, IL

visitor_notes: Any kind of bike is fine. Volunteers will check tires, chains and brakes before the ride.
description: A family ride on the Kickapoo Rail Trail: out and back as far as you like, at no set pace. Kids, parents and grandparents are welcome, on any bike, with trailers, tag-alongs or training wheels. Volunteers can help with chains, tires and brakes before the roll.
evidence: Prairie Cycle Club's group rides page lists 2026 dates for this ride including Oct 9 and Oct 23, 5:45 PM meet and 6:05 PM rollout (read Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: The club page lists the year's dates. The next dates after Oct 23 will be on the same page.

name: Thursday Evening Ride
schedule: Thursdays, 6:00 pm, from Porter Park in Champaign.
visitor_notes: Check the club page for any fall start-time change.
description: A brisk evening ride through the Champaign area at 16 to 20 mph, 20 to 35 miles. It is the club's faster weeknight group.
evidence: Prairie Cycle Club's group rides page, which carries 2026 dates for other rides, lists the Thursday Evening Ride at 6:00 PM from Porter Park, 16-20 mph (read Oct 1, 2026). The page does not date this ride.

refresh.notes: The club page gives the schedule but not dates for this ride. The start time may move with daylight in the fall.

name: Thursday Pedal to Pec

start_location.name: Faith Center, rear parking lot (S. Main at Pelley Roads)

name: 3RVS Wednesday Short & Sweet Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, 6:00 pm, from the Veterans War Memorial. Rides started the week of May 4, 2026. New start location for 2026.
visitor_notes: Visiting cyclists are welcome. Check the club calendar and Facebook page for cancellations.

name: IVW Monday Morning Ride
schedule: Mondays, 9:00 am, from either the Eureka Water Tower or Five Points in Washington. The start is posted each week on the club's Facebook pages and email list.

start_location.name: Eureka Water Tower or Five Points, Washington (varies by week)

description: A no-drop Monday morning ride of 30 to 40 miles, led by club members. Each week's start and route go out on the club's Facebook pages and email list.

name: Joe Zanchi Rehab Monday Ride
schedule: Every Monday, 5:15 pm, from the Big Four Bridge, year-round, weather permitting. Post-ride at Parlour in Jeffersonville, Indiana.
pace: Moderate to quick tempo, about 16 mph
visitor_notes: Not usually swept. Tell the group you are new.
description: A moderate to quick tempo ride at about 16 mph over a 20-mile route, run by Louisville's Ridenfaden group. It is usually not swept, so tell the riders if you are new and someone will stay with you.
evidence: Crazy Ridenfaden Cyclists' site (footer 2026) lists the Zanchi Rehab ride Mondays at 5:15 pm from the Big Four Bridge, and its event calendar lists club events on Oct 3 and 4, 2026 (read Oct 1, 2026). The page does not date this ride.

refresh.notes: The about page states the weekly schedule. The club's event calendar lists extra rides.

name: Cleveland Critical Mass
schedule: Last Friday of the month, 7:00 pm, from Public Square.
description: A monthly Critical Mass ride that leaves Public Square on the last Friday of the month. The Cleveland Touring Club's public calendar lists it under non-club events.
evidence: The Cleveland Touring Club's public Google Calendar of non-club events lists Cleveland Critical Mass monthly on the last Friday at 7:00 pm from Public Square, added April 3, 2026 (read Oct 1, 2026). The next is Fri Oct 30.

refresh.notes: A calendar line only; the organizers' own page was not found. Check local social media before going.

name: Soul Roll Detroit
schedule: Mondays and Saturdays, rolling out at 7:00 pm from Eastern Market Shed 5. The calendar runs both through Oct 31, 2026; earlier entries say meet at 6:00, roll at 7:00. Sometimes canceled for weather.
description: A multicultural group ride from Eastern Market. The organizers say nobody gets left behind and everyone stops if a bike breaks down. A 2023 BridgeDetroit guide put the pace at 10 to 12 mph.
evidence: The Detroit Greenways Coalition's community calendar, with entries edited in April 2026, lists Soul Roll Detroit Mondays and Saturdays at 7:00 pm from Eastern Market Shed 5 through Oct 31, 2026 (read Oct 1, 2026). The coalition says it does not host these rides.

refresh.notes: A community calendar the Detroit Greenways Coalition keeps; it does not host the rides. Soul Roll's own Facebook group has the latest, including weather cancellations.

host.name: Saturday Night Roll Outs on the Joe
